notes: All 4 pages. Excluded: header/section underlines and the equal-access notice. Table and form cells are their interior inset 1pt; underlined blanks follow the underline convention; date blanks are one box per printed MM/DD/YY group; phones split at the printed parentheses; SSN is 3 groups. 'am'/'pm' next to the call-time blanks are option words (one choice box each). Multi-line answers are one box per printed line; only the first line carries the path. The four employer blocks on page 1 map to employment_history[] columns (one block per item). The 10 'name the source' blanks in Referral Source each map to referral.detail (a correct template fills the one matching the checked category conditionally; the condition is not scored). Pathless by design: best-time-to-call hour/minute/am/pm, and checkboxes inside repeated structures (employer-block Hourly/Salary and May-we-contact boxes, education Completed boxes, computer-skills 'Other' rows), since a checkbox cannot be a table column.
